summary: Enhance your understanding of Value Added Tax with our comprehensive training course. Gain essential skills and knowledge to navigate VAT effectively.
lede: International VAT training explains how value-added tax applies to supplies, input tax recovery and cross-border transactions. It is designed for tax and finance professionals responsible for accurate reporting, covering supply classification, input tax calculations, invoice and record management, and VAT return preparation. Topics also include place-of-supply rules, reverse-charge accounting, e-invoicing and ERP tax logic.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for financial accuracy and tax compliance within a commercial or governmental environment.
modules: Place of Supply and Tax Jurisdiction
Input Tax Recovery and Partial Exemption
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of accounting principles and experience working within a finance, tax, or compliance function. Familiarity with basic business transaction cycles (Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash) is recommended. No prior specialist knowledge of VAT law is required, as the course builds from core concepts to intermediate application.
